body:
Adds `research/rollout-commons`: rollout sharing in decentralised RL post-training modelled as a public-goods game.

- Symmetric Nash gives every agent a lone agent's learning level regardless of swarm size; efficient welfare grows with N (4.5x at N=256).
- At theta=1 only the best a/c agent generates.
- A Pigouvian matching subsidy implements the optimum exactly (checked against a projected-Newton optimiser).
- Junk-rollout deterrence condition c - eps > p(tau + F).
- 7 stdlib unit tests, reproducible experiments, white paper, portfolio page and README entries.
